text: I think green spaces are important because people in big cities have a lot of stress, and parks help them relax. Also, trees make the air cleaner, so it is better for health. For example, in my city, many people go to the park after work to walk. But I think many cities don't have enough parks because the land is expensive, and companies want to build offices there.

tips.en: Cause and result make the reasoning logical.
tips.kk: Себеп пен салдар пайымдауды логикалы етеді.
tips.ru: Причина и следствие делают рассуждение логичным.
tips.example: because people in big cities have a lot of stress

tips.en: A concrete example makes the answer convincing and shows the idea is grounded.
tips.kk: Нақты мысал жауапты сенімді етіп, ойдың негізді екенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Конкретный пример делает ответ убедительным и показывает, что мысль не пустая.
tips.example: For example, in my city, many people go to the park after work to walk

questions.question: Why are green spaces important in big cities?

text: I think the government should spend money on both, but hospitals and schools are more important. Parks are nice, but people can't live without doctors. But parks are not very expensive, so the city can build them too. If there are no parks, children play in dangerous streets. So I believe the government must find a balance and not forget about children.

tips.en: Contrast shows two sides of the issue, which works well in Part 3.
tips.kk: Қарама-қайшылық сұрақтың екі жағын көрсетеді — Part 3 үшін күшті тәсіл.
tips.ru: Противопоставление показывает две стороны вопроса — это сильный ход для Part 3.
tips.example: Parks are nice, but people can't live without doctors

tips.en: A complex structure (conditional, passive, subordinate clause) raises Grammatical Range.
tips.kk: Күрделі құрылым (шартты, ырықсыз етіс, бағыныңқы) Grammatical Range-ді арттырады.
tips.ru: Сложное предложение (условное, пассив, придаточное) повышает Grammatical Range.
tips.example: If there are no parks, children play in dangerous streets

note.en: to share attention fairly between two things

text: People can take their rubbish home or put it in the bins. They shouldn't leave bottles or bags on the grass. Also, they can join volunteer days and clean the park together. In my country, some people do this, but not many. I think we need more signs and bigger fines, because some people just don't care until they must pay money.

tips.en: Hedging sounds natural and shows you are weighing the opinion.
tips.kk: Сақ тұжырым табиғи естіледі және пікірді саралап жатқаныңызды көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Осторожная формулировка звучит естественно и показывает, что вы взвешиваете мнение.
tips.example: I think we need more signs and bigger fines

tips.ru: Противопоставление показывает две стороны вопроса — это сильный ход для Part 3.

text: I think cities will have less nature because more and more people are moving there, and they need houses. But maybe some cities will build gardens on roofs and walls, which is a good idea. In Singapore, for example, there are many trees on tall buildings. I hope other cities will copy it, because we need nature for our health.

tips.en: Hedging sounds natural and shows you are weighing the opinion.
